title: Keep the Core Tee (decoy): do not discontinue

payload.note: No write. Tag product for review after P-002 lands.

impact.method: scenario step 33 (keep; counterfactual cut at 10% basket halo = -$26.1k, breakeven halo 1.65%)

risks: Basket halo is unproven: mixed baskets with the tee are not more profitable per order ($74 vs $84 without).
If P-002 is rejected, the tee stays slightly CM-negative on an allocated basis (-$5.3k by revenue, -$20.5k by units).
TEE2FOR50 multi-buy is itself CM-negative (-12.4%); revisit it if the threshold stays at $50.
